trials.description: C0/T1 equal fundamental deterioration Short control
low PIT annualized CFO yield Short

feature_definitions.long: exact C0/T1 M60 residual momentum, skip 1, EWMA alpha=0.25
feature_definitions.V1: annualized CFO / (raw Close * PIT disclosed issued shares), disclosure age <=450 calendar days; invalid values neutral
feature_definitions.V2: (Profit-CFO)/TotalAssets from one valid same-period disclosed record, disclosure age <=450 calendar days; invalid values neutral
feature_definitions.V3: max of residual returns t-20 through t-1, 20 observed days required; missing history neutral
feature_definitions.rank_and_ties: daily percentile; missing=0.5; stitch tie-break by fixed Long rank then Code
feature_definitions.idio_vol: lagged residual 20-day standard deviation, diagnostics only

model: Fixed rule-based 40% C0/T1 Long plus independent 40% Short / 20% neutral ranking over the remaining 60%
